Climate action ambition is raised, in Colombia, Thailand, Zambia, and Pakistan, through the use Article (A6) cooperative approaches that can engage the private sector in NDC implementation.Cost-efficient, flexible, high integrity carbon markets with positive sustainability impacts are developed. Transformative design of A6 pilots for real ITMO transactions is achieved through re-search-based capacity building in four partner countries, catalysing a HA-CoP regionally and globally.
